thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: eu-central-1 GPU hotpool saturation + failed autoscale attempts. High 429s observed at edge proxies. Paging oncall. https://metrics.example.com/alerts/4109999999 :rotating_light:

oncall-ana: on it. Anyone have quick snapshot of node health and queue?

sre-jin: queue_length jumped from ~900 to ~4800 in ~7m, concurrency climbing, hotpool CPU/GPU util ~99%. Autoscaler attempted 4 scale-ups but cloud returned quota errors around 02:13 UTC. 429s started at 02:10 and spiked at 02:15.

eng-runtime-lee: digging into tokenbucket logs — looks like a recent config deploy left `token_window_ms` unset for tier=enterprise which defaulted to 0 -> effectively starving regen calc for that tier. Requests accumulated and hit hotpath. Also found rate-limiter JSON `burst` entries set to 0 for some shards.

infra-ops-maya: cloud quota shows us at account GPU limit. There's a backlog of pending node requests pr-21011. Can approve but creation will take ~4m. Ops policy requires approval to bump limit.

support-karim: customers: 9 tenants with >40% errors; two enterprise customers reporting timeouts for inference jobs. Raising status page draft.

oncall-ana: mitigation plan: (A) push emergency token regen fallback for affected tiers to non-zero, (B) approve cloud quota prewarm to allow immediate nodes, (C) relax strict tier routing so silver/gold can use dedicated fallback pools. Who can do A and C?

eng-runtime-lee: I'll apply emergency regen: patching controlplane: ```
PATCH /api/v1/tiers/enterprise
{"token_regen_per_sec": 30, "token_window_ms": 60000}
```

ml-ops-ravi: I'll apply routing relax: change `tier_lockdown` false for timeframe, patch rp-4419. Also adding a short-term fairness tweak to avoid starving silver when enterprise gets regen bump.

infra-ops-maya: approved pr-21011 via `opsctl approve pr-21011 --by=maya --fast` — cloud provisioning started.

sre-jin: nodes initializing. After token regen patch, 429 rate dropped ~73% in 3m. Queue length halved, still elevated but draining.

support-karim: customers A & B acknowledging partial recovery. Posting update: "Mitigations applied; services recovering; errors declining. Working on full capacity restoration."

oncall-ana: note: don't forget to capture affected request counts for postmortem. Karim can you pull logs for 2h window?

support-karim: pulling now. Preliminary: 2h window from 01:50–03:50 UTC: 950k requests, 429s 14.8k (~1.6%), peak per-min 429 7.9%. Top callers: chat-proxy, bulk-embed, sync-worker.

prod-mgr-sasha: immediate action items for post-incident: 1) fail-safe default for token_window (eng-runtime-lee), 2) pre-approval workflow for autoscaler quota (infra-ops-maya), 3) CI validation for rate-limiter bursts (ml-ops-ravi).

eng-runtime-lee: adding a temporary reversion job to controlplane: `controlplane schedule-revert --id=4109999999 --after=15m` so we don't leave regen high accidentally. Will add a followup PR to validate our tier defaults.

ml-ops-ravi: also saw a deploy race where new rate-limiter shards had stale `burst=0` merged. Will roll a hotfix to set `min_burst=5` in config generation and add unit test.

incidents-bot: System: controlplane change detected (user=eng-runtime-lee), routing patch rp-4419 applied by ml-ops-ravi, ops approval by infra-ops-maya. Audit entries created.

sre-jin: monitoring window: keeping this thread open for 1h. If metrics remain stable we'll mark stabilized and collect artifacts for postmortem.

oncall-ana: handoff: I'll be off in 18m. @sre-jin take lead; @infra-ops-maya ensure quota increase fully applied; @eng-runtime-lee watch revert timer.

infra-ops-maya: cloud report: new nodes became ready at +5m, autoscaler accepted new capacity. No further quota errors.

support-karim: customer status updated and targeted outreach started for top-affected tenants.

prod-mgr-sasha: logging note: capture request ids for failures for customer outreach and attach to postmortem.

eng-runtime-lee: final config note: we'll change default behavior so unset `token_window_ms` falls back to 60000ms instead of 0. I'll open PR now.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Please escalate if errors reappear.

sre-jin: thanks team — will monitor and then draft timeline. Closing comments in 1h if green. :white_check_mark:
